title: Distance to ENMESH — Kenshi .exe integration roadmap

layer_0_mesh_parsing.what: Ogre v1.100 binary .mesh parser in Rust

layer_1_dll_injection.what: RenderSystem_Vulkan_x64.dll loads inside kenshi_x64.exe via Plugins_x64.cfg
layer_1_dll_injection.proof: dllStartPlugin() called by Ogre, log file written

layer_2_ogre_hooks.what: Root::getSingletonPtr() + getAvailableRenderers() hooked from inside the .exe
layer_2_ogre_hooks.proof: D3D11 RenderSystem found, vtable pointer read

layer_3_msvc_abi.what: MSVC std::string SSO layout (32 bytes), std::vector layout understood

layer_4_renderer.what: WGPU/Vulkan renderer with lighting, camera, depth buffer

layer_5_world_map.proof: 12 biomes, 21 creatures, globe overlay serving on LAN

layer_6_vtable_scan.status: READY — need one Kenshi relaunch with v0.6.0 DLL
layer_6_vtable_scan.what: Run the investigator DLL to dump D3D11's full 64-slot vtable with RVA offsets
steps: 2. Copy to Kenshi directory as RenderSystem_Vulkan_x64.dll
4. Launch Kenshi — investigator runs during plugin load
5. Read kenshi_reborn_vtable.json for full slot map
layer_6_vtable_scan.risk: LOW — v0.6.0 is read-only, doesn't register anything

layer_7_dropdown.what: Clone D3D11 vtable, patch getName → 'Vulkan (Reborn)', register with Root
steps: 1. Use vtable scan results to identify getName slot
4. Build fake RenderSystem with patched vtable
layer_7_dropdown.risk: MEDIUM — if we miss which slot is getName, Kenshi could crash. But we restore instantly.

layer_8_render_intercept.what: When user selects 'Vulkan (Reborn)', intercept Ogre render calls → forward to WGPU
steps: 1. Implement _createRenderWindow() to create WGPU surface instead of D3D11
3. Implement _render() to draw geometry with our pipeline
4. Handle all ~30 pure virtual methods in RenderSystem base
layer_8_render_intercept.distance: WEEKS of work — this is the full engine replacement
layer_8_render_intercept.risk: HIGH — needs every virtual method to not crash

layer_9_fcs_mods.what: Create .mod files for Kenshi's FCS system
what_we_know: gamedata.base is the master FCS file (4.4MB binary)
Newwworld.mod is the main content mod (2MB)
FCS binary format is partially documented by community
RE_Kenshi (Rust) can parse FCS — but we don't install external tools
layer_9_fcs_mods.distance: Need to write our own FCS parser in Rust

TONIGHT_REALISTIC: ✅ Run vtable investigator (1 Kenshi relaunch, 5 min)
✅ Build the dropdown DLL from scan results (30 min)
⏳ FCS parser — stretch goal, needs format research
